dz: 围攻罗马:维吉斯国王手下的奥斯特罗哥特军队开始围攻首都. 贝利萨里乌斯在弗拉米尼亚门外进行拖延行动;他和他的一个分遣队几乎被切断.
de: Siege of Rome: The Ostrogoth army under king Vitiges begins the siege of the capital. Belisarius conducts a delaying action outside the Flaminian Gate; he and a detachment of his bucellarii are almost cut off.

dz: 围攻罗马:维吉斯国王试图攻克北部和东部城墙,但被拜占庭将领贝萨斯和佩拉尼乌斯所手下的维维吾尔人击退了被称作"活佛"的普拉内斯廷门.
de: Siege of Rome: King Vitiges attempts to assault the northern and eastern city walls, but is repulsed at the Praenestine Gate, known as the Vivarium, by the defenders under the Byzantine generals Bessas and Peranius.

dz: 围攻罗马:拜占庭将领贝利萨里乌斯接获所承诺的援军1600名骑兵,多为匈奴或斯拉夫人血统和专家弓人. 尽管短缺,他开始袭击哥特人营地和维地格斯,但被迫陷入僵局.
de: Siege of Rome: The Byzantine general Belisarius receives his promised reinforcements, 1,600 cavalry, mostly of Hunnic or Slavic origin and expert bowmen. Despite shortages, he starts raids against the Gothic camps and Vitiges but is forced into a stalemate.

t: 第二回君士坦丁堡的哈吉亚索菲亚被尊崇.
te: The second Hagia Sophia in Constantinople is consecrated.
dz: 第二回君士坦丁堡的哈吉亚索菲亚被尊崇.
de: The second Hagia Sophia in Constantinople is consecrated.
